notes: Key fixes: the single-word h-suppression now uses the same rule as multi-word — suppress h only when the *original* word is all-lowercase, ends in o/y, and was changed by collapse. This fixes `hello`→`helo` (no h) and `jello`→`jelo` (no h), while `Hello`/`HELLO` keep h and `follow`→`folw` keeps h (collapsed form ends in `w`, not o/y).
